planning_notes: Board is arduino:avr:uno. Only explicitly wired pins from the provided inventory are represented: A0 (analog input) and D2 (digital input). No other ports/devices are added because no other wiring was specified.

Serial requirement: output A0 potentiometer value and D2 button state once per second at baud 9600 using framing line_or_idle (idle_timeout_ms=20). Exact textual line formatting (single-line vs two lines, separators, CR/LF) is not specified; this proposal assumes the application will emit two typed numeric/boolean values for the grouped trigger.

Digital input polarity: not specified in the requirements; active_high is set to true as a default assumption because the catalog default may differ. If D2 is actually wired active-low, SysML should interpret the model accordingly (do not add a second inversion).
Control period chosen as 10 ms to support accurate once-per-second gating using elapsed_ms; actual once-per-second behavior belongs in the SysML model, not in these interface requests.
